---
title: I'm Back
date: 2022-04-12
---

It has been awhile, huh? I'll try to get back to updating this space more frequently. 

I just read [this piece published over at the Atlantic](https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2022/05/social-media-democracy-trust-babel/629369/) that reminded me why I deleted my Facebook and decided to switch over to writing a blog in the first place. Admittedly, I'm still addicted to doomscrolling Twitter and Reddit. Maybe it'd be good to wean myself off of those too. 

I don't really have a ton to say, just wanted to share that essay and update Gatsby (the framework that's running this blog). Ya know - make sure I could still actually build the site. I will try to write little things more frequently here, though.
